metadata.description: Public marketplace of the agent-brain core: one plugin in two channels, brain-core (stable) and brain-core-next (beta). Every entry pins a release tag of this repo, never main - an untagged change reaches nobody. The pins move only on the core owner's word (AGENTS.md #12); scripts/suite-check.py fails an entry whose ref is not an existing release tag.

plugins.name: brain-core
plugins.description: Stable channel of the agent-brain core: the general-purpose skills listed in skills/REGISTRY.md, the caveman output style and the audit workflows. From tag v2.0.4 on the plugin also ships the core's hooks (hooks/hooks.json); they run the helpers of a brain's core/ submodule (ONBOARDING.md, step 3). This pin moves to a tag only after it ran as a beta without regression.

plugins.name: brain-core-next
plugins.description: Beta channel of the same plugin, pinned at or ahead of brain-core: for a machine that checks a release before it goes stable. Enable this OR brain-core, never both - they ship the same skills and hooks. Which systems a beta was checked on stands in CHANGELOG.md and in the release notes of its tag.
